title: Gaps in education span the learning cycle and adulthood, leaving a trace along the life course
source: Source: EU-MIDIS II and HBS 2017 data

sections.title: Participation is lower at every stage of education

content.content:
##### Participation is lower at every stage of education

Participation is lower at every stage of education. Roma children and young people are less likely than their non-Roma neighbours to be enrolled at every stage, from preschool to university. The largest gaps come before primary school and at upper secondary level, when continued study can open the way to further qualifications and work.
